description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mawela, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Cad. Map No. 330324
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land classifications. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
